propositions: Three separate code paths for verifier model selection break the configured standard class by falling back to the default provider when they should apply the operator's class configuration
Code review's verify step declares no model key and resolves to cfg.model (the frontier model), losing determinism from its temperature:0 setting
Provider-qualified model ids defeat equality-based downgrade heuristics that compare against bare default model names, causing silent inheritance of frontier models across provider changes
Verifier model resolution must converge on a single reserved-word resolver (resolve_model_string) to prevent drift between plan-review, completion, and code-review paths
The equality test `cfg.model == DEFAULT_MODEL` must be replaced entirely with explicit class-name resolution to distinguish operator override from provider change
